themes.title: Trump-Meloni feud escalates ahead of NATO summit
themes.blurb: Right-wing media across the US and Italy are intensely covering the public spat between Donald Trump and Giorgia Meloni, with Trump repeatedly mocking Meloni on social media. The feud has become a dominant transnational story, overshadowing the upcoming NATO summit in Turkey and raising concerns about alliance unity.

themes.title: PP-Vox coalitions reshape Spain's regional governments
themes.blurb: Spain's conservative Partido Popular (PP) and far-right Vox have formed coalition governments in multiple regions, including Andalusia, following the 2026 regional elections. This theme reflects the broader trend of right-wing alliances gaining power across Europe, with media in Spain, Italy, and France closely monitoring the policy shifts and political implications.
